Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending the draft Order Form and security exhibit. We reviewed and have three asks before we can move to signature: 

1) Pen test language — we need a clear definition of scope (staging vs prod), minimum notice, and whether Redwood will redact or mask production data during tests.
2) Evidence cadence — we expect SOC 2 report delivery within 30 days of year-end and a lightweight quarterly evidence packet for controls changes. How will that be surfaced?
3) Access routing — if you require ephemeral staging credentials, we need details on onboarding and logging.

I attached our annotated exhibit (Catalyze_Security_Exhibit_Redline.xlsx). Can we do a quick sync this week? Our preferred window is Thu morning.

Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications: pen test windows & evidence cadence

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and then I propose specific redline text.

- Pen test scope: Redwood's standard position is that penetration testing requiring access to production data requires a documented justification and an executed narrow-scoped addendum; otherwise tests should be performed against staging with production-equivalent datasets (sanitized). We are open to a bounded production test for high-priority customers with pre-approved controls and escrowed evidence collection.
- Notice: Our standard is 30 days notice for a pen test that involves non-admin access; we can accept 14 days for vulnerability scanning only.
- SOC 2: We commit to delivering the SOC 2 Type II report within 30 days of issuance; quarterly change packets will be pushed to a shared drive link and a short digest emailed to your security contact.
- Access routing / onboarding: We use ephemeral SSH/SSO accounts, timeboxed to the window, and full session logs retained for 90 days.

I'll attach a proposed redline for the security exhibit and the Order Form appendix. Can you confirm Thu 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min sync?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

(attachment: Redwood_proposed_redline_security_exhibit.txt)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications: pen test windows & evidence cadence

Adding a few practical items from the ops side (so we can scope engineering work):

- Pen test redline: propose adding this clause (suggested language):

  "Penetration Testing: Customer-initiated penetration testing of Redwood systems must be limited to non-production environments unless Customer provides a written justification and both parties execute an addendum specifying allowed accounts, data handling, redaction requirements, and monitoring obligations. Redwood will require a minimum thirty (30) calendar days' advance notice for tests that involve requestable access beyond vulnerability scanning. Redwood will retain session logs and evidence for ninety (90) days following the test and will provide an evidence bundle (logs, findings, remediation summary) via a mutually agreed secure transfer method within five (5) business days of remediation completion or test conclusion, whichever is later."

- Evidence cadence: ops can publish a quarterly controls-change digest (short CSV + short notes) to the shared drive link; we should include a line in the exhibit that SOC 2 reports and interim change notices will be published to the drive and notified by email within 5 business days.

- Staging access: to limit support lift, staging accounts will be time-limited (default 72 hours), require SSO enforcement, and use recorded sessions. We need Catalyze to confirm their list of IPs for allowlisting if they want direct access.

I'll be on the Thu 10:00 AM PT call — thanks for setting up.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
